art_prompt: Vintage bootleg-style baseball graphic, faded distressed texture, blank oval photo insert frame with dotted stitch outline for a player photo, arched ribbon banner at top, crossed bat and ball icon below, halftone shading, colors black, white, mustard gold, brick red, customizable team-color trim, text arched above the illustration and stacked beneath the photo frame
title: Custom Softball Baseball Player Shirt, Personalized Name Number, Vintage Style Tee, Team Color Gift for Kids
description:
Give your ballplayer a shirt as loud as your cheering section. This personalized design gets your kid's name, number, and team colors printed right on a distressed, retro-inspired graphic that looks straight out of an old-school locker room.

Every order can be customized with your player's info and team palette, so no two shirts look alike. Soft, durable print built to survive a full tournament schedule of dugouts, dirt, and doubleheaders.

A fun, affordable gift for birthdays, team parties, or the first game of a new season. Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
risk_notes: Generic sports imagery and original wording with no team names or logos referenced.

flags.msg: Illustrations didn't pass the Art Director, so this uses a typography layout instead.
